Happy 23rd, Asu Di! ❤️

I am SOOOOOO grateful to God that I have you. You always manage to make me smile, laugh, and somehow forget whatever sadness I have whenever I’m with you. I literally act like a child around you because you bring out my inner child without even trying. I don’t know how you do it, but somehow even when I’m not in the mood, being around you just makes everything feel better.

I miss you so much, my Asu Di. I still remember the day I told you I was born in 2006 and you were like, “Omg, you’re too young. I cannot be friends with you.” 😭 And look at us now. I genuinely never imagined that we would become this close. I’m so happy that somewhere along the way, you became someone I could rely on and not just a friend, but a sister to me, even if we don’t have the same blood.

I miss our stupid laughs, going on random errands together, you coming to my college just so we could eat lunch, and even those times when we weren’t really doing anything but were just happy being around each other. I miss having you around for all the random little things.

Please come soon because I have so many things I want to do with you again☹️☹️☹️☹️. I want our random plans, random conversations, random laughs, everything back.

I love you soooooo much, my pretty girl. And one thing I really love about you is that you’re always so beautiful inside and out, but you never make people feel like they have to be anything other than themselves. You’re always the one telling me to do whatever I want and just go for it, and I hope you know how much that means to me.

Happy birthday again, Asu di❤️

love pri💕
